name: r3-dispatch-blank-device-eui
_comment: N1 (dispatch r3): with DEVICE_EUI whitespace only, String(env.get(DEVICE_EUI) || UNKNOWN).trim() is "": the manual command topics are devices//command_ack and devices//status, and the status names gatewayDeviceEui "".
